title: What drinking only soda does
description:
Can by can: what a day of nothing but soda does to your blood sugar, teeth, weight and sleep.
#soda #sugar #science #health
AI-free animation made with code. Not medical advice.

music.credit: Music: "Hyperfun" - Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), licensed under CC BY 4.0

lines.hook: What happens if you drink only soda?
lines.b1: One can of cola packs about ten teaspoons of sugar.
lines.b2: Two cans spike your blood sugar, and your body pumps out insulin.
lines.b3: Three cans bathe your teeth in sugar and acid, wearing down enamel.
lines.b4: Four cans add over five hundred calories, and weight can creep up.
lines.b5: Six cans by bedtime, and the caffeine can keep you wide awake.
lines.end: How many cans do you drink a week?
